maria_pm: GA: Hosted 'Low-Latency' bundle (LL-B) is officially live. :tada:

maria_pm: TL;DR — new endpoint, two tuned models, streaming+tool-calling support, cost tier and SLA details below.

maria_pm: What is included:
- endpoint: `POST /v1/hosts/ll-b/generate` (single-tenant routing for low p99)
- models: `fastlane-ll-3b`, `fastlane-ll-7b-quant` (quantized)
- streaming/tool-calling: enabled by default for LL-B
- latency header: `X-Redwood-Latency-Mode: low` (opt-in)

maria_pm: Rollout schedule:
- today: GA for new signups + internal orgs
- Tue 09:00 UTC: +10% of existing hosted traffic routed to LL-B (canary)
- Wed 09:00 UTC: +50% if no regression alerts
- Fri 09:00 UTC: full traffic for orgs opted into low-latency tier

maria_pm: Pricing & SLA:
- unit pricing: +15% per-token vs standard hosted models
- SLA: 99.9% p99 latency target per minute when `X-Redwood-Latency-Mode: low` is set
- fallback policy: if latency SLO breached, requests will automatically degrade to `standard` model family

maria_pm: Docs & runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/ll-b-ga (internal link)

sam_sre: Great work team. Key ops notes:
- runbook is at the docs link (page includes playbook + metrics dashboard links)
- monitors: `llb.p99.latency`, `llb.errors.rate`, `llb.kvcache.hit_rate`
- alert thresholds pre-configured for canary: p99 > 350ms for 3m

jia_eng: Compatibility note: SDKs v0.9.8+ include helper `client.latencyMode='low'`. Older SDKs will need to set header manually.

kevin_devex: I'll add quickstart snippets and a migration guide. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosts/ll-b/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Latency-Mode: low" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"fastlane-ll-3b","prompt":"Summarize the release notes"}'
```

ana_security: Security checklist:
- KMS keys unaffected
- Ensure private orgs pin model versions if they require deterministic outputs
- Audit log events: `llb.request` emitted for all requests

ops-bot: deploy: LL-B service rolled out to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 at 2025-06-10T08:15:03Z :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary: +10% traffic rule applied (id: canary-llb-20250610)

maria_pm: Callouts for teams:
- Sales: we have a short promo sheet for low-latency tier — ping me if you need region-specific pricing
- Support: please triage `llb.*` alerts to SRE on-call; use runbook
- Platform: expect a config flag in org settings to opt into LL-B

maria_pm: Open questions? We'll host a 30m sync tomorrow 16:00 PT in #announcements for any cross-team blockers.

kevin_devex: :rocket: will share quickstart PR + snippets before EOD.

sam_sre: I'll watch the canary dashboards overnight and post any anomalies here.

maria_pm: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if you saw this.
